content: SQLite search scale: at hundreds of rows a LIKE '%q%' linear scan is sub-millisecond; FTS5 pays off only around ~100k docs and token-based matching loses substring semantics (trigram needs >=3 chars). SQLite LIKE/upper fold ASCII only — Cyrillic case-insensitivity requires the unicode61 tokenizer or a custom fold — which this project already solved with the norm() better-sqlite3 UDF + *_normalized twin columns (write-side fold, 0.76ms/600 rows validated).
